# NILO — a real jam game (third party)

**NILO** by Rojen Maharjan, made for **js13kGames 2020** (theme "404").
Source: https://github.com/js13kGames/nilo · Entry: https://js13kgames.com/2020/games/nilo · License: MIT (see `LICENSE`).

The files here (`index.html`, `bundle.js`) are the **unmodified** official build from the repository's `.website/game.zip`. We did not write or change any of it, and we have no relationship with the author.

We use it as the benchmark's hard case: a real game that we did not make, with no Ghostrun SDK, so the ghosts can only use the pixels on screen (menus, mouse buttons and an unusual "refresh the page" mechanic included).

> In this game the player is inside a virtual web browser and can refresh the page (SPACE) to make certain platforms disappear for a short time.
> — from the game's README
